component.name: Refrain
component.summary: Discord Rich Presence for Apple Music on Linux

description.p: Refrain shows what you are listening to on Apple Music as your Discord status — whether the audio is playing in your browser (music.apple.com) or streaming from your iPhone over Bluetooth.

ul.li: Reads playback metadata from MPRIS (Apple Music in any major Linux browser)
Reads playback metadata from BlueZ AVRCP (any AVRCP-capable Bluetooth source)
Forwards track info plus iTunes-resolved cover art to Discord
System-tray icon with Play / Pause / Next / Previous controls
Settings window for sources, privacy mode, autostart and Bluetooth device picker

description.p: Settings UI overhaul: every tab now uses a consistent GroupBox + form-layout with left-aligned titles, fixed-width inputs that hold across Plasma Breeze and other Qt styles, and a compact 220 px field default (360 px for the Discord group whose values need more room). Notification cover-art flicker is gone — `notify-send -i` and `image-path` now carry the same image so KDE Plasma can't briefly render the brand badge. Discord RPC defers the first update for a new track until the cover URL is in cache so the brand fallback never flashes in the activity card. Apply now auto-restarts when the Discord client_id changes (same pattern as the language switch). Dead D-Bus watcher code removed (155 lines), atomic config writes, AppImage updater validates downloaded size, RPC reconnect backoff capped at 15 s instead of 60 s.

First minor-version release. Five new features plus a batch of polish: theme-aware tray icons that follow the system dark/light scheme; idle detection that drops the Discord status when an MPRIS source is dangling; D-Bus PropertiesChanged listeners so track changes register instantly instead of within a poll tick; a first-run welcome wizard with live Discord IPC + iTunes diagnostics; translation infrastructure with German shipped and stubs for FR / ES / IT / PT / NL / PL / JA / ZH_CN open for community PRs. Discord activity layout cleaned up so the three RPC lines show title, artist, and album one per line.

Three real bugs caught during the Flathub demo recording. Skip Next/Previous now works on Apple Music in Chromium — when KDE's plasma-browser-integration owns the rich metadata but reports CanGoNext=False, controls fall back onto the browser's own MPRIS player. Discord status now renders as "Listening to <song>" instead of "Playing Refrain" (was wrong activity_type). The tray-icon tooltip mirrors the live progress so users get a real timer (DBusMenu doesn't refresh the menu's text while open, so the menu's own progress line was visibly frozen mid-song).

Same-day follow-up to v0.1.3 fixing the two issues v0.1.3 shipped with: AppImage filename was rendered as "Refrain-.version.-x86_64.AppImage" because of a broken {version} placeholder, and the AppImage icon wasn't bundled because the icon_bundler walks XDG icon paths but the recipe used files.include. Both fixed. Plus AUR refrain and refrain-git are now live, and the Flatpak manifest is validated locally end-to-end against KDE 6.10 + the PySide BaseApp.

Start-on-Login now works for venv / pipx / pip --user installs (the autostart .desktop no longer assumes `refrain` is on $PATH at session-startup time). The noisy Qt XDG-portal warning is suppressed in the live log. PyPI publishing is wired into the release workflow via Trusted Publishers, so installs via `pip install refrain` now Just Work.

More production-readiness: empty Discord client_id no longer spams reconnect attempts, the cover-art toggle is now actually honored by the desktop notification, AppImage restart uses $APPIMAGE explicitly, the AppImage build recipe was fixed, and the tray menu shows a Discord connection indicator. Reset-to-defaults and Open-log-folder buttons added to Settings → Advanced.
Reliability fixes for desktop notifications, in-app Restart (tray + Settings), CodeQL false-positive suppressions, and minor dead-code cleanup.
